title: Hot reloading does not reload all files
body:
(Created from #823)

While hot reloading will reload a changed file, it does not appear that changes are actually used. For example, a changed file in the `paths/` directory will be reloaded. However, those changes have no effect until the `_.context.ts` file is reloaded as well.

## Steps to reproduce
### Setup
Have a file structure like so:
```
counterfact/
    paths/
        _mocks/
            my-custom-code.ts
        _.context.ts
```

In `_.context.ts`:
```ts
import { CustomClass } from './_mocks/my-custom-code';

console.log("_.context.ts loaded");
// Do stuff with CustomClass
```

In `./_mocks/my-custom-code`:

```ts
console.log("Custom code loaded");

const value = "Some value that's used in generating a mock response";

class CustomClass {
  // Use value in here somehow as part of generating a response
}

export { CustomClass }
```
### Trigger

1. Run counterfact (ex: `npx counterfact spec.openapi.yaml counterfact`)
2. Call counterfact api, see the `"Some value..."` in the HTTP response
3. Modify the custom code string to be something else (`"const value = "Changed!"`)
4. Note that `Custom code loaded` is logged
5. Make a request to counterfact. Note that the new value is not returned

However, if I trivially modify the `_.context.ts` file (touch it, add a comment, etc), I do see counterfact log the `_.context.ts loaded` message. If I then make a new HTTP request, I see the new value in the mock http response.

title: [BUG] Recursive models generate invalid typescript
Context file cannot find modules in counterfact 0.40+
body:
I upgraded from `0.38.3` to `0.42.0` to try out the new hot reloading changes (#835). Unfortunately, the app no longer works at all.

## Setup
I have custom counterfact code in a sub-folder of my little UI project, like so:
```
my-ui/
	...files...
	package.json
	counterfact/
		path-types/
		paths/
			mocks/ <-- my custom code
				session-manager.ts
			_.context.ts
		package.json
```

I have a lot of custom code in that `/mocks` directory, but I'm simplifying things here to a minimal test case.

### counterfact/package.json
```json
{
	"name": "my-ui-counterfact",
	"version": "0.0.1",
	"private": true,
	"scripts": {
		"mockapi": "counterfact ../path/to/my/openapi.yaml ."
	},
	"devDependencies": {
		"counterfact": "^0.42.0"
	},
	"type": "commonjs"
}
```

### counterfact/paths/_.context.ts
```ts
import { SessionManager } from './mocks/session-manager';

const sessionManager = new SessionManager();

export class Context {
	someCustomFunction(): any {
		return sessionManager.toString();
	}
}
```

### counterfact/paths/mocks/session-manager.ts
```ts
class SessionManager {}
export { SessionManager };
```

## Error

With all that in place, when I run `my-ui/counterfact> npm run mockapi`, I get the following:

```
...
Watching for changes
Starting server
Starting REPL, type .help for more info

Error loading /Users/.../my-ui/counterfact/.cache/_.context.cjs:
Error: Cannot find module './mocks/session-manager'
Require stack:
- /Users/.../my-ui/counterfact/.cache/_.context.cjs
- /Users/.../my-ui/counterfact/node_modules/counterfact/dist/server/uncached-require.cjs
```

Please let me know if my setup is unsupported/I'm doing something wrong, if you cannot reproduce, or if this is a genuine bug.

title: Type error on custom json response
body:
The linter gives the error here on the **GET** const. So the type passed into the json does match, and is not causing a type error. But the response returned has some type error with HTTP_GET.

This worked before, but appeared after updating to latest. So somewhere between 0.37.1 and 0.42.1

```ts
import type { HTTP_GET } from '../../../path-types/api/Lansumsoknir/ListaUmsoknir.types.js'

export const GET: HTTP_GET = ($) => {
  return $.response[200].json($.context.lansumsoknir)
}
```

Here is the error, also translated via TotalTypescript
```ts
Type '($: OmitValueWhenNever<{ query: { namsar?: number | undefined; stada?: string | undefined; }; path: never; header: never; body: never; context: Context; response: ResponseBuilderFactory<{ 200: { headers: never; requiredHeaders: never; content: { ...; }; }; 400: { ...; }; 500: { ...; }; }>; x: WideOperationArgument; ...' is not assignable to type 'HTTP_GET'.
  Type 'GenericResponseBuilderInner<{ content: Omit<{ "application/json": { schema: UmsoknSottUmContract[]; }; "text/json": { schema: UmsoknSottUmContract[]; }; }, "application/json">; headers: never; requiredHeaders: never; }>' is not assignable to type '"COUNTERFACT_RESPONSE" | { status: 200; contentType?: "application/json" | undefined; body?: UmsoknSottUmContract[] | undefined; } | { status: 200; contentType?: "text/json" | undefined; body?: UmsoknSottUmContract[] | undefined; } | { ...; } | { ...; } | { ...; } | { ...; }'.ts(2322)
Translation
Type '($: OmitValueWhenNever<{ query: { namsar?: number | undefined; stada?: string | undefined; }; path: never; header: never; body: never; context: Context; response: ResponseBuilderFactory<{ 200: { headers: never; requiredHeaders: never; content: { ...; }; }; 400: { ...; }; 500: { ...; }; }>; x: WideOperationArgument; ...' is not assignable to type 'HTTP_GET'.
I was expecting a type matching HTTP_GET, but instead you passed ($: OmitValueWhenNever<{ query: { namsar?: number | undefined; stada?: string | undefined; }; path: never; header: never; body: never; context: Context; response: ResponseBuilderFactory<{ 200: { headers: never; requiredHeaders: never; content: { ...; }; }; 400: { ...; }; 500: { ...; }; }>; x: WideOperationArgument; ....

Type 'GenericResponseBuilderInner<{ content: Omit<{ "application/json": { schema: UmsoknSottUmContract[]; }; "text/json": { schema: UmsoknSottUmContract[]; }; }, "application/json">; headers: never; requiredHeaders: never; }>' is not assignable to type '"COUNTERFACT_RESPONSE" | { status: 200; contentType?: "application/json" | undefined; body?: UmsoknSottUmContract[] | undefined; } | { status: 200; contentType?: "text/json" | undefined; body?: UmsoknSottUmContract[] | undefined; } | { ...; } | { ...; } | { ...; } | { ...; }'.
I was expecting a type matching "COUNTERFACT_RESPONSE" | { status: 200; contentType?: "application/json" | undefined; body?: UmsoknSottUmContract[] | undefined; } | { status: 200; contentType?: "text/json" | undefined; body?: UmsoknSottUmContract[] | undefined; } | { ...; } | { ...; } | { ...; } | { ...; }, but instead you passed GenericResponseBuilderInner<{ content: Omit<{ "application/json": { schema: UmsoknSottUmContract[]; }; "text/json": { schema: UmsoknSottUmContract[]; }; }, "application/json">; headers: never; requiredHeaders: never; }>.

const GET: HTTP_GET
```


So this GenericResponseBuilderInner is not matching the expected HTTP_GET returnType of 

```ts
{
      status: 200
      contentType?: 'application/json'
      body?: Array<UmsoknSottUmContract>
    }
```
